note: Experimental, EU vehicles only (US Sprinter NCV3 profiles are not compatible). Needs a firmware with the ATWU wake-up commands, see W906.md in github.com/mcgyver78/WiCAN_W906.
comment: Engine ECU (Delphi CRD3) is addressed physically on 7E0/7E8. CAN captures with Xentry show the diagnostic bus starting its traffic right after the first tester frame to 7E0, so a physical TesterPresent (as Xentry pads it with 55) is used as wake-up frame. Mode 01 PIDs are the ones reported as supported by a EU W906 in meatpiHQ/wican-fw#520 and still need to be verified on the OM651.
